burton-brink.text: Pledges to "Support a strong Arcadia Police Department, Arcadia Fire Department, and all first responders" and "Invest in crime prevention and community policing."

burton-brink.text: "I will fight Sacramento's overreach, protect our property values, support our businesses, and deliver common-sense conservative leadership on the City Council." Also pledges to "Encourage responsible development that respects our character."

source.title: Issues - Burton Brink for Arcadia City Council District 2

burton-brink.text: Pledges to "Protect taxpayer dollars," "Prioritize essential services," and "Carefully review all spending and obligations."

burton-brink.text: Endorsed by the Arcadia Police Officers' Association and the Arcadia Firefighters Association, IAFF Local 3440.

burton-brink.text: Told the council (Sept. 15, 2026) of his police and fire union endorsements: "Some people call those groups 'special interests.'... I will always stand with the men and women who protect this city."

source.title: News - Burton Brink for Arcadia City Council

burton-brink.text: "I am not accepting any campaign contributions. This campaign is funded entirely with my own personal money. I will not be bought or influenced by special interests."

source.title: Burton Brink for City Council, Arcadia District 2

sharon-kwan.text: Cast the lone vote against the FY2026-27 budget (June 16, 2026, 4-1). "I voted against the budget because I am concerned about the City's long-term fiscal sustainability."

source.title: Arcadia City Council Regular Meeting Minutes, June 16, 2026

sharon-kwan.text: Said General Fund "spending is growing more than three times faster than revenue" and that reserves "should be treated as a safeguard for emergencies... not as a substitute for maintaining long-term structural balance."

source.title: Kwan explains lone vote against Arcadia budget - HeySoCal

sharon-kwan.text: On seven vacant police officer positions saving over $2 million: "public safety should not be used as a hidden balancing tool." Says she has repeatedly asked about a police drone program.

source.title: Kwan: Arcadia budget doesn't show 'full picture' of city's finances - HeySoCal

sharon-kwan.text: "The city approved significant employee compensation increases in 2024, including raises of more than 18% for employee groups... Those decisions create long-term costs."

source.title: Kwan: Arcadia budget doesn't show 'full picture' of city's finances - HeySoCal

sharon-kwan.text: Cast the lone no vote (June 16, 2026) against overturning the Planning Commission's denial of a 30-unit SB 330 condominium project at 514 Fairview Avenue.

source.title: Arcadia City Council Regular Meeting Minutes, June 16, 2026

sharon-kwan.text: Opposed a council appointment to the vacant District 3 seat in favor of letting voters decide: "I do not believe four councilmembers should make that decision for them."

source.title: Deadlocked Arcadia council delays appointment to seat vacated by admitted spy - HeySoCal

sharon-kwan.text: (2022) "My priorities as a City Council member will be public safety and maintaining our strong property values... I know the importance of keeping a balanced budget and being fiscally responsible."
